Delhi Court Denies Bail in Satya Niketan Building Collapse Case

A Delhi court has denied bail to the operator of a paying guest (PG) accommodation in Satya Niketan in connection with a building collapse. The court observed that the PG operator, who is a qualified legal professional, should have been aware of the regulations and prioritized financial gain over safety. The court stated the matter must be dealt with an iron hand.
